releases.notes:
# Adaptive Performance Manager 1.6.2

Bug-fix + feature release focused on the FPS limiter and auto-optimization.

## 🐛 Fixed
- **FPS limiter now actually works at any value.** A software, frame-paced limiter caps at 10–1000 FPS — vanilla silently treated anything above ~260 as "unlimited", which is why setting 350 still gave 1000+ FPS.
- **Optimize My Game** no longer overrides your cap with a forced 260; it unlocks FPS via the new **Unlimited FPS** toggle + **VSync off**.
- **Auto-optimize** runs once immediately when enabled, and the 1–60 min interval is applied live.

## ✨ New
- **Unlimited FPS** toggle and **Max FPS** (10–1000) stepper.
- **VSync** toggle — turn it off to break the monitor-refresh-rate lock (e.g. stuck at 165).
- **Emergency FPS Lock** — optional, toggleable cap with your own value, applied only during the emergency stage.
- Idle throttle now drives the software limiter for reliable focus/restore.

## ℹ️ Versions & loaders
This build targets **Fabric 1.21.1** (Fabric API + Java 21). A single Fabric jar only runs on the version it is remapped for, and Forge uses a different loader — so 1.16.5→latest and Forge require separate per-version/per-loader builds (Architectury + Stonecutter). The code is structured for that port; back-ports can be attached as extra release files. See the README for details (English + Türkçe).

## Install
1. Install Fabric Loader + [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
2. Drop `adaptive-performance-manager-1.6.2.jar` into `mods`.
3. Launch, press **Right Shift**. Optimize with **Delete**.

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

releases.notes:
# Adaptive Performance Manager 1.5.3

Adaptive, real-time FPS/CPU/RAM optimization for Minecraft Fabric. Client-side, server-safe, free & open-source.

## Highlights
- **Adaptive 5-stage optimizer** with intelligent cooldowns and gradual restore.
- **Framerate control** — Max FPS + VSync toggles. Turn VSync off to break the monitor-refresh-rate cap (e.g. stuck at 165).
- **Optimize My Game** — one click, guaranteed FPS uplift (uncaps framerate, disables VSync, tunes graphics).
- **Auto-optimize scheduler** (every 1–60 min), **idle throttle**, **memory guard**.
- **Live dashboard** (Right Shift) with FPS/frame-time/memory charts and CPU/GC telemetry.
- **6 profiles**, smart recommendations, integrations (Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, FerriteCore, Iris).
- **11 languages**, switchable in-app.

## Install
1. Install Fabric Loader and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
2. Drop `adaptive-performance-manager-1.5.3.jar` into your `mods` folder.
3. Launch and press **Right Shift**. Built for Minecraft 1.21.1 (1.19.4+), Java 17+.

See the full changelog in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).
